light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Leí los comentarios de otros videos de cola casera, y la pregunta que más se repite es esta.
clips.action: he uncrosses his arms and holds up a phone in his right hand, glancing at the screen then at the lens. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: "Si es cola de carpintero… ¿por qué nadie la prueba en madera?" Y tienen toda la razón.
clips.action: he lowers the phone and nods, serious. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Porque casi todas esas recetas son engrudo. Harina con agua, cocida. Esto de acá.
clips.action: he picks up the small bowl of white flour paste and tilts it toward the lens. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: El engrudo sirve para papel, para cartón, para una piñata. En madera, no aguanta.
clips.action: he pokes the flour paste with a finger and rubs it between two fingers, shaking his head. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.line: Mi abuelo pegaba todo con engrudo, y se le despegaba todo.
clips.who: the neighbour, a stout man of about 65 with a thick grey moustache and a light-blue checked shirt (the fourth reference image)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man
clips.text: Mi abuelo pegaba todo con engrudo, y se le despegaba todo.
clips.action: The neighbour steps in from the door and talks to the presenter, waving a hand dismissively; the presenter listens, silent, smiling.

clips.text: ¡Claro! Porque la harina no es un pegamento de carpintero. Lo que usaban los carpinteros era otra cosa.
clips.action: he laughs, points at the neighbour, then puts the bowl down and picks up the jar of honey-coloured glue. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Esta es cola de caseína. La caseína es la proteína de la leche. Durante muchísimo tiempo se pegaron muebles con esto.
clips.action: he turns to the lens and tilts the jar so the thick glue flows slowly. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Antes de que existieran las colas sintéticas, esta era una de las colas de los carpinteros.
clips.action: he sets the jar on the bench and rests his palm on an old wooden chair standing beside the bench. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Y la segunda pregunta que más se repite: "¿cuánto dura?", "¿no se pone fea en el frasco?".
clips.action: he looks back at the phone for a second, then at the lens. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: La verdad: en el frasco dura poco. Se hace y se usa en el día. No es para guardar.
clips.action: he pockets the phone and taps the lid of the jar twice. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Hay quien le pone conservantes para que dure en el refrigerador. Yo no lo recomiendo: la cola vieja pega peor.
clips.action: he shakes his head, holding the jar up at eye level. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.text: Lo que dura años es la unión, ya seca. La cola en el frasco, no. Eso hay que tenerlo claro.
clips.action: he picks up a glued pine joint from the bench and knocks on it with his knuckles. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.

clips.line: ¿Y con leche del refrigerador sirve, o hay que comprar algo especial?
clips.who: the neighbour, a stout man of about 65 with a thick grey moustache and a light-blue checked shirt (the fourth reference image)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man
clips.text: ¿Y con leche del refrigerador sirve, o hay que comprar algo especial?
clips.action: The neighbour, now curious, leans on the bench and asks, pointing at the jar; the presenter listens, silent.

clips.text: Sirve la del súper, pero tiene que ser descremada. Al final te muestro por qué, con una prueba. Vamos.
clips.action: he answers the neighbour with a nod, then turns to the lens and gestures toward the inner door of the house. The neighbour (fourth reference image) stays where he is, listening, silent.
